name: Shopify Admin API
tagline: Manage products, orders, customers, inventory, and store data via REST or GraphQL.
description: Shopify Admin API lets apps and integrations manage a merchant's store: products, variants, inventory, orders, customers, fulfillments, discounts, and more. Developers can use REST or GraphQL over HTTPS against shop-specific endpoints, with OAuth for public apps and access tokens for custom apps. It is the primary backend surface for Shopify app development and store automation.

auth.details: OAuth 2.0 for public/custom apps (Bearer access token); custom apps also use Admin API access tokens from the Shopify admin. Scopes required per resource.

pricing.free_tier_limits: API access included with Shopify store plans; Partner/dev stores free. No per-request API fee for standard Admin API usage — store subscription required.
pricing.paid_plans: Shopify store plans (Basic and up); app billing via Shopify Billing API optional for public apps.

rate_limits: REST: 2 req/s bucket (leaky); GraphQL: cost-based (points/sec). Plus plans higher. Exact limits vary by plan and version — see docs.
use_cases: list products and variants for a Shopify store
create or update orders and fulfillments
fetch customers and order history for CRM integration
manage discounts, price rules, or gift cards
subscribe to webhooks for order/product changes
